bibl.title: PSI XIII 1364, hermeneiai al Vangelo di Giovanni.
bibl.seg: Guido Bastianini, PSI XIII 1364, hermeneiai al Vangelo di Giovanni.
Paola Davoli & Natascia Pellé (edd.), Πολυμάθεια. Studi Classici offerti a Mario Capasso (Lecce, 2018) pp. 125-138, figg.
bibl.note: P.S.I. XIII, 1364 (= van Haelst 1177, LDAB 5797) is perhaps a leaf of a miniature codex (V/VI A.D.) containing ἑρμηνεῖαι to the Gospel of John, without the Johannine text itself: such a codex was perhaps used for bibliomantic purposes.
